A.title: Duo selfie under the pergola
A.text: This is a candid photograph taken with a smartphone of two women posing for a selfie in an outdoor dining area under bright sunlight. The woman in the foreground has shoulder-length brown hair, wears a black strapless top and small hoop earrings, while her companion behind her has long blonde waves, a dark sleeveless top, white bottoms, and a pearl necklace. They stand before a rustic stone wall and a wooden pergola structure against a clear blue sky.

A.title: Bathroom mirror blowout
A.text: A young Latina woman taking a side-profile selfie in her bathroom mirror to show off her brand new, bouncy blowout and layers. She is holding her phone slightly out of frame so the camera captures the movement of her hair. She is wearing a plain white tank top, and the bathroom features white subway tiles and warm, slightly yellow overhead lighting.

A.title: Canal walk with sign text
A.text: This is a candid photograph taken with a smartphone of a woman standing on a paved canal walkway, angled in profile while smiling toward the left. She has long brown hair with sunglasses perched atop her head and wears a navy blue blazer over an unbuttoned white blouse paired with grey trousers. A pearl necklace rests at her neck, and she holds a black handbag by her side. Behind her, modern brick buildings line the waterway, including one labeled "IGMODEL" in large silver letters above glass storefronts.

A.title: Beanie, cat, snowy window
A.text: This is a candid photograph taken with a smartphone of a woman in a beige knit beanie holding a brown tabby cat against a window. She wears a puffy grey winter jacket, cradling the feline which has white-tipped paws and green eyes looking forward. Behind them, snow-covered trees and a wooden fence are visible through the glass pane.
